system:
Convert the attached marking rubric into JSON. Keep descriptor meaning; condense wording.
- ids C1..Cn in rubric order. Marks are numbers; a single mark gives min=max.
- max = max marks for the criterion. weight = % of total if stated, else null.
- If only % bands are given, use 0-100 for level min/max and max=100.
Schema: {"title":str,"total":num,"criteria":[{"id":"C1","name":str,"weight":num|null,"max":num,"levels":[{"label":str,"min":num,"max":num,"desc":str}]}],"notes":str}
Reply with one JSON object only. No prose, no markdown.
